title: Empirical Science of Perspectival Semantic Measurement: Master Frontier Synthesis

point_1_direct_relational_testing.conclusion: Relational measurements are substantially more reproducible (ICC(3,k)=0.7875) than the framework-averaged scalar (ICC(3,1)=0.3965, test-retest r=0.3016); dense semantic proximity does not constrain framework-conditioned stance.

point_2_structural_realism_invariants.conclusion: Effective spectral rank is conserved at 5-6 (spectral entropy 1.58-1.84); 5 core articles remain persistently extremal across >=3 independent political ontologies.

point_3_commensurability_phase_transitio.conclusion: Continuous conceptual distance exhibits smooth translation decay (R^2 1.0 -> 0.208), while operator shifts exhibit sharp non-linear cliff collapses at alpha > 0.7 (R^2 0.914 -> 0.029).
point_3_commensurability_phase_transitio.methodological_disclosure: Evaluated via numerical score-mixture interpolation Q(alpha) = (1-alpha) S_A + alpha S_B; cliff degradation reflects score manifold geometry rather than continuous linguistic prompting.

point_4_empirical_underdetermination.conclusion: Multi-criterion external match (Top-5 pub acc Delta=0.000, ANOVA F Delta=0.13, Sentiment R^2 Delta=0.007) conceals large subspace divergence (d_Grassmann=1.9058, sign-aligned |r|=0.7557).

point_5_quinean_indeterminacy.conclusion: Empirical analogue of translation indeterminacy: conceptual translation exhibits a 9.13x surge in model prediction dispersion under empirical co-adequacy (sigma^2=0.0286 vs self-translation sigma^2=0.0031).

point_6_mechanistic_constitution.conclusion: Causal activation patching reveals that hypothesis state transplant shifts stance output by >85% across layers 8 to 20, tapering to 57% at layer 22 and 0% at layer 24, confirming hypothesis conditioning operates across intermediate/late joint self-attention.

point_7_semantic_gauge_freedom.conclusion: Fails preregistered gauge criterion (R^2=0.5981 < 0.85); paraphrase is 59.8% coordinate-reducible under affine mapping compared to 12.3-20.9% for conceptual and 2.9% for operator comparisons.

point_8_semantic_supervenience.conclusion: Relational stance is not recoverable with useful accuracy from tested framework-blind text representations (R^2<=0.0695), but is substantially recovered once relational interactions are admitted (R^2=0.5931).

point_9_philosophical_twins.conclusion: Concrete twin pairs with dense embedding distance d_cosine=0.0128 separate by 2.91 sigma under Strategic Security while differing by only 0.027 sigma under IHL.

point_10_possibility_space.conclusion: Sampled probe-bank cloud occupies a compressed possibility space (20.35% estimated geometric volume of ambient random reference [-1, 1]^8, intrinsic dimension 6.77).

point_11_anomaly_migration.conclusion: Geometrically more distant perspectives agree less about which articles are anomalous: Pearson r=-0.6902, Spearman rho=-0.6578, both decisively surviving 10,000-permutation Mantel/QAP dependence testing (p_Mantel < 0.0001).

point_12_observer_space_geometry.conclusion: Static conceptual distance metrics on hypothesis prompts fail to predict observational subspace geometry under QAP testing (DeBERTa p_Mantel=0.2522, TF-IDF p_Mantel=0.0975).

point_13_human_benchmarking_protocol.conclusion: Preregistration-ready protocol formalizing 4 human reader panels (N=60) with power > 0.999 to detect Procrustes alignment R^2>=0.50 and design-projected D-study reliability E rho^2_AP(15)=0.8929.
